headlines.title: Judge blocks Trump’s Postal Service regulation on mail-in ballots
headlines.description: The judge said the regulation is most likely unlawful because the president can’t insert the federal government into elections without Congress’ approval.

headlines.title: 'Dear Donald': Battleground district voters share their message to Trump
headlines.description: On his final day of the NBC News Drive to Decision Day series, NBC News senior national politics reporter Jon Allen joins Meet the Press NOW from Nebraska to recap his trip and hisvisit to the “blue dot” district.

headlines.title: 'I am not running for president,' Attorney General Todd Blanche says at Iowa State Fair
headlines.description: On day five of his Drive to Decision Day series, NBC News senior national politics reporter Jon Allen joins Meet the Press NOW to break down his one-on-one with Attorney General Todd Blanche at the Iowa State Fair in Des Moines.

headlines.title: ‘Fed up with a war they didn't want’: Midwestern voters air frustrations impacting the midterms
headlines.description: Senior National Politics Reporter Jonathan Allen joins Meet the Press NOW to discuss his conversations with frustrated voters on the ground in Iowa and Ohio ahead of the midterms in his Drive to Decision Day series.

headlines.title: ‘Resign. You’re destroying the country’: Republican voter in key Ohio district slams Trump
headlines.description: NBC News Senior National Politics Reporter Jon Allen cruises down I-80 in his Drive to Decision Day series to talk to voters in several battleground congressional districts that could determine the control of Congress. On day 3 of his road trip, Jon Allen visits Ohio’s 7th and 9th congressional districts.

headlines.title: Trump ‘doesn’t have a plan’ on Iran: Voters in key Pennsylvania district upset with handling of war
headlines.description: NBC News Senior National Politics Reporter Jon Allen hits the road for his Drive to Decision Day series to talk to voters in several battleground congressional districts that could determine the control of Congress. Jon Allen starts his road trip in New Jersey’s 7th congressional district and Pennsylvania’s 7th and 8th congressional districts.

headlines.title: Judge hits DOJ lawyers with barrage of questions on Kennedy Center changes
headlines.description: Justice Department lawyers said in a court filing this week that keeping Trump’s name off the performance center could lead to its being demolished.

headlines.title: Trump orders Lake Ontario renamed ‘Lake America’
headlines.description: President Trump’s order to rename Lake Ontario comes amid the growing trade war between the U.S. and Canada. NBC News’ Garrett Haake reports.

headlines.title: CIA chief asked Russia not to share intel with Iran during visit to Moscow
headlines.description: CIA Director John Ratcliffe asked Russia’s top spy chief not to share intelligence that could be used against the U.S. with Iran. NBC News Senior National Security Correspondent Courtney Kube reports on what was discussed in that meeting.

headlines.title: Canada’s Carney responds to Trump’s executive order renaming Lake Ontario to ‘Lake America’
headlines.description: President Trump signs an executive order renaming Lake Ontario ahead of his trip to Texas where Democrats are looking to expand their midterm map. NBC News’ Monica Alba and Sahil Kapur and the Cook Political Report’s House of Representatives Editor Erin Covey discuss the midterm landscape.

headlines.title: Trump imposes 50% tariffs on dairy, alcohol, and cars from Canada
headlines.description: The Trump administration imposed 50% tariffs on three categories of imports from Canada, dairy, alcohol, and cars, citing discriminatory actions. NBC News' Monica Alba reports on how Trump is also considering additional tariffs due to the Canadian wildfires.

headlines.title: The GOP’s underlying midterm problem: From the Politics Desk
headlines.description: In today’s edition, Jonathan Allen breaks down the greatest obstacle facing the Republican Party in the midterms.
